descriptionMarkdown:
Skull n Bones is the final expression of mastery over chaos, a ship not defined by excess, but by balance.

Every system aboard is tuned, not overbuilt. Power generation meets demand with precision. Fuel flows exactly where it’s needed, no more, no less. Where other vessels rely on brute force or redundancy, Skull n Bones relies on harmony between its parts.

And when it moves, it moves.

Its engines are capable of extraordinary speed, cutting across the fractured remains of the planet with unsettling ease. But beyond the edge of the solar system, where distance warps intuition and supply lines become memory, that speed becomes a liability. Out there, momentum is risk.
title: Skull n Bones
